Holley for Brentwood City Council District 4
# Rooted in Brentwood. Focused on Our Future.
I’m Holley Bishop-Mello, Brentwood born and raised, a mother, small business owner, and Human Resources professional with more than 25 years of experience solving problems. I want to keep our community safe, strong, and a great place to raise a family.
Experience that matters
## 25 Years of Practical Problem-Solving
My background in Human Resources and as a small business owner has taught me the value of listening, building consensus, and finding practical solutions. These skills are essential for effective local governance.
I grew up in Brentwood and understand what makes people call it home. I'm committed to protecting those qualities as we plan thoughtfully for responsible growth and a vibrant future.

A Commitment
## Listening Leadership for Brentwood's Future
Good governance begins with genuine engagement. Holley pledges to maintain open communication, ensuring every District 4 voice is heard and valued in city decisions.
A Commitment to Community
#### Good leadership starts with listening, and I’m ready to work for the people of Brentwood.
Holley Bishop-Mello
Get Involved
## Join Our Grassroots Effort
Your voice and support are vital to building a stronger Brentwood. Together, we can make a difference.
